context:
Goal: the phone's Packages card looks like the web, and its audits pass.
Problem (rule): four step 7 accessibility audits flag "Contrast failed" on a checked-off row's detail line, such as "Test Set · Near Mint". The colour pair measures 4.51:1 by the tokens, which is above the 4.5 floor, and it is the web's own colour. Decision audit-skips-measured-flags allows only skips you name, so a new skip needs your word.
Based on (record): debt tally-audit-contrast-flags; the audit samples pixels and flags pairs above 4.5:1 some of the time.
Based on (ruling): audit-skips-measured-flags, owner 2026-10-27 12:25 CDT; you named a skip for the same kind of flag on the Tally "left" line.
Departs from: main audit-skips-measured-flags names four contrast skips — adds a fifth, the done-row detail line, contrast check only.
Meanwhile: Restyle works on. Nothing waits on this.

options.gain: The audits go green, and the web colour stays.
options.how: The four audits skip only the contrast check, only on that line. Every other check stays on.
options.label: Add a named contrast skip for the done-row detail line
options.lose: The audit stops checking that one line's contrast.

options.how: Step 7 merges with the four audits failing, logged in the debt, as step 5 did.
options.label: Merge step 7 with those four audits red
options.lose: Four red audits on main that readers learn to ignore.

ref: decision audit-skips-measured-flags (audit skips only for measured false flags); debt tally-audit-contrast-flags (the audit flags pairs above 4.5:1)
title: Step 7's audits flag a checked-off row's detail line that measures 4.51:1. Add a named skip?
why: The pair clears the floor by the tokens, and you ruled the same way for the same kind of flag.
